hero.name: Aarav
hero.family: my mother (who set the 6 pm study timer and never let me skip the review), my father (who drives me to every tournament and asks one question after each game: "which move?") and my little sister Diya, who learned the moves by watching

posts.title: 1600: the first step
body: 20 October 2026. Today my CC Rating on Chess Castles touched 1619. When I started, in October, it said 1500 "(new)" and I lost my first three games in a row. Between then and now: 10 sessions, 50 rapid games (15+10, never faster: my coach, Deshpande sir, a FIDE Master who runs the Saturday class at our school says fast games only teach you about the clock), 27 wins, 7 draws, 16 losses.

The game I remember most is the one I lost as white against the 1500 in session 2: 17. Rae1 (Blunder) and 19. Qf3 (Blunder). The review marked the turning point as 19.Qf3 by me, 25% of the winning chances gone in one move. My father asked his question in the car: "which move?" I knew the answer this time, and that is the whole point of the review.

Openings: the Caro-Kann Defence as Black (answer 1.e4 with ...c6 and ...d5, keep the pawns healthy, and be happy to reach an endgame); the Jobava London as White (d4, Nc3 and Bf4 early, with the knight jumping to b5 to hit c7); the Chebanenko Slav as Black (the Slav with ...a6: hold d5 and get ...b5 in). Each time the same routine from Learn → Openings: the course page, one model game played through, the trainer, and only then the line against a FIDE-rated opponent. From those lines in this stretch: 13 wins, 6 draws, 11 losses.

The rest of Learn, one thing a session: rated puzzles; Guru's strategy lesson; a Guru review of one of my games; an endgame lesson; my last game checked against the 5.4 million games; an endgame from a master's own game; a blindfold puzzle in the Blindfold Gym; a live grandmaster game with the engine on; a new opening in the trainer.
My profile says: accuracy 95%, opening 93, middlegame 94, endgame 98; sharp moments 98 and calm moves 95. The sharp number is up, which is what the puzzles were for.
5 wins against an opponent one level up (1500, 1400, 1600, 1700, 1700). My mother says that is the one that counts.
All my games so far: 50, 27 wins, 7 draws, 16 losses; 63% as White and 48% as Black. Next stop: 1700.
